seed.description: In sectionsByTitle, the trailing-newline normalization changed from /\r?\n$/ to /\r?$/. The regex no longer removes the final \n of a released section, so a section that differs from base only by a missing final newline is reported as edited. This is a realistic regex-edit slip (a dropped escape) and breaks the commit's own test 'ignores a missing terminal newline when comparing released sections'.

seed_verification.seeded_result: 11 pass, 1 fail: ignores a missing terminal newline when comparing released sections

real_defect.description: The merged change itself (the 'clean' fixture) strips one trailing /\r?\n$/ from every released section, so a section whose last line changes from LF to CRLF compares equal. That breaks requirement 2 (a line-ending change must fail). Commit 3ddc9792, the same day, moved the strip to the end of the whole file only.
real_defect.found_by: Both arms of the 2026-10-12 pilot, in all three trials, before anyone had noticed it.

verification.command: releasedSectionsEqual(edited, base) with a heading-only section, and with a last line directly before the next heading, changed from LF to CRLF
